sessionName: PC Assembly (CPU, RAM, GPU, HDD, SSD)

parts.name: CPU
parts.place: Move the CPU over the large square CPU socket in the middle of the board, then release to place it.

wrong.dimm: That is a memory (DIMM) slot. The CPU goes in the large square socket.
wrong.pcie16: That is a PCIe slot. The CPU goes in the large square socket.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a PCIe slot. The CPU goes in the large square socket.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. The CPU goes in the large square socket.

parts.name: RAM module
parts.place: Move the RAM over a DIMM slot (the row of long slots), then release to seat it.

wrong.pcie16: That is a PCIe slot. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a PCIe slot. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.

parts.name: Graphics card (GPU)
parts.place: Move the GPU over the long PCIe x16 slot, then release to seat it.

wrong.dimm: That is a DIMM (memory) slot. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.pciesmall: That slot is too short. The GPU needs the long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.

parts.name: HDD SATA cable
parts.place: Drag the cable plug to one of the blue SATA ports on the motherboard, then release to plug it in.

wrong.dimm: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
wrong.pcie16: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
wrong.pciesmall: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
wrong.cpu: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.

parts.name: SSD SATA cable
parts.place: Drag the cable plug to a free blue SATA port on the motherboard, then release to plug it in.

wrong.dimm: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
wrong.pcie16: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
wrong.pciesmall: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
wrong.cpu: That is not a SATA port. Use the blue SATA ports near the bottom edge of the board.
